arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course-fitted current; a drop means extra drag (weed on rudder) or a local current change

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: weed on rudder or adverse local current?

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.12 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 180 and remaining_m > 1000
arguments.message: shaft power well above critical power after the start

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.88 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 600
arguments.message: shaft power well below critical power
pod reserve below 30 percent with more than 1200 m to go
pod reads near zero while boat moves: pod failure?

arguments.text: PLAN (8000 m, legs 1250 m out-and-back). Pre-race CP: shaft 157 W, boat 98 W (may be 10-25 pct off). Aim: shaft power near CP (~157-165 W) through mid race; trust pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) over boat reserve. Final sprint (finish cue) when pod reserve allows, roughly 600-900 m left. Watches set: drag_jump (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.2: weed -> consider clear_rudder), too_hot, too_soft, pod_reserve_low, pod_dead. If shaft power holds above CP with no fade for 10+ min, CP is underestimated: consider set_critical_power. At 1 min: start hot (210 W shaft), let it settle.

text: no cue: start is hot as expected; set plan note and watches for drag, overpacing, underpacing, reserve and pod failure

arguments.text: Settle a touch, hold 166 pace, long race ahead

4 min (747 m): shaft 175 W (12 pct over CP 157), pod reserve 57 pct, empties in 1600 m. Cued ease to 166 s/500 over ground (~160 W shaft). Boat reserve reads 17 pct vs pod 57 pct: boat/shaft power ratio in race 0.70 vs test 0.62, so boat CP 98 W probably too low (or efficiency changed). Trust pod reserve; revisit boat CP later.

text: cued ease to 166 s/500: shaft power 12 pct above CP would empty the pod reserve in 1600 m

arguments.text: Ease to 171 pace, recover, plenty left for the finish

6.9 min (1278 m, leg 2 heading south): paddler said cooked. Shaft still 172-175 W (ease to 166 not followed in power: speed fell 3.21->3.04 m/s at same shaft power, fade -2.2 pct, boat/shaft ratio 0.74->0.63; push_local fell +0.16->-0.05 gradually and did not flip at the turn, so not current). Fatigue or slow drag build-up. Boat reserve 0, pod reserve 41 pct. Cued ease to 171 s/500 (~158 W shaft). Next: check shaft drops to ~155-160 and speed per shaft power stabilises; if push_local keeps falling at lower power, suspect weed -> clear_rudder. Avoid long get_metric_series windows (huge output).

text: cued ease to 171 s/500: paddler cooked, shaft power still 12 pct over CP and speed fading at constant power

arguments.text: Good, that is the effort. Hold this, smooth and long.

9.9 min (1827 m): after ease, shaft 155 W (= CP), pod reserve stable 39 pct, speed 3.04-3.06 m/s (same as at 172 W: extra power was wasted), push_local +0.08, fade -3 pct. Display pace 164. Cued hold (no pace target) to lock ~155-160 W shaft and replace the 171 target. Boat reserve stuck at 0 (boat power 110 W > boat CP 98): boat CP likely low but not changed yet; rely on pod. Pod reserve 39 pct over 6.2 km allows ~3 W above CP plus a final sprint.

text: cued hold: shaft power now at CP with stable pod reserve; replaces the slower 171 pace target

arguments.reason: boat power 110-116 W held 6+ min with boat reserve at 0 and fade recovering (-4 to -1.9 pct); pod shows shaft at CP 157 W with stable reserve; race boat/shaft ratio ~0.72 gives boat CP ~112 W

arguments.text: 12.9 min (2380 m): shaft 160 W, pod reserve steady 38 pct, speed rising 3.08 m/s, fade back to -1.9 pct, push_local +0.09. All on plan, no cue. Set boat CP 98->112 W (1 of 3 uses) so boat reserve is a usable cross-check if the pod fails. Plan: hold ~158-162 W shaft; finish cue around 700-900 m left if pod reserve still ~35 pct.

text: no cue: pacing at CP with steady pod reserve and recovering speed; corrected boat CP to 112 W

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 6750 m

arguments.text: Course shortened one leg. Finish at 6750, about 4 km left.

14.5 min (2680 m): RADIO course shortened one leg, finish now 6750 m. Set race distance 6750 and told paddler (distance_left 4080). Pod reserve 33 pct, shaft 167 W heading north on leg 3. Next: check new sustainable_shaft_power_w; a modest push (to ~165 W) may now be affordable; finish cue ~700-900 m left (i.e. around 5900-6050 m). Leg layout now: turns at 3750, 5000, 6250; finish 6750 is 500 m into the last leg.

text: set race distance to 6750 m and told the paddler 4 km left, per race committee radio
